$comment: A3 shortlist for A2's decisions page — 'which augmentation first'. #277 2026-09-16 lane A3 (Fable), pinned bedf383, reads A1 13a4cf2. Nothing enacted. Full argument: A3-AUGMENT.md.

shortlist.name: ASK
shortlist.plain: A command that takes one of the twelve designer questions and a node id and returns the answering slice of the graph — a few hundred tokens with the join class and Dave's sentence on every edge — instead of a 200K-token file read.
shortlist.cost: one Opus lane, ~1 day: _ask_kg.py (12 verbs, --budget, --fetch) + 12 selftest bites + runbook paragraph; query-time 20-600 tokens per question
touches: pack: shipping the baked graph JSON is a release (P-269-1 pin)
shortlist.s274_D12: PASS — reads ratified edges only, declares UNANSWERABLE with the missing type

shortlist.name: CLOSURE
shortlist.plain: Compute the missing direction of every ratified edge and the chains for containment at build time, mark them derived and dashed, never write them where a human authors — so a sink kind like context can be a starting point and 'is this ruling still in force' is one hop.
shortlist.cost: half an Opus lane: INVERSE/TRANSITIVE tables in _build_kg_explorer.py after extract_extra(), $derived label, explorer chip; +~6,600 derived edges if all bake
touches: P-269-6 (inForce is its query half; window stays parked)
shortlist.s274_D12: PASS for inverse/transitive over STRUCTURAL edges; chain inference across the PROSE `cites` edge REFUSED

shortlist.name: SHAPES
shortlist.plain: Write down once what a node of each kind must be connected to and what each edge type may point at, and have the build report every node that falls short — so 'orphan' means something and the explorer header stops printing 0.
shortlist.cost: half an Opus lane: knowledge/_kg-shapes.json + _validate_kg.py checks (g) shape conformance and (h) full-graph islands/orphans, advisory; joinClass on every baked edge
touches: s274-D9 / s276-D6 (advisory vs blocking is Dave's)
A2 §2 per-kind minimums become this file's content

shortlist.name: TOKENS
shortlist.plain: Put the design tokens in the graph the way the DTCG 2025.10 spec models them — a token aliases the token it references, a component binds the tokens it uses — so 'what breaks if I change text/default' is a two-hop count instead of a 595K-token read.
shortlist.cost: one Opus lane, ~1 day: gen_kg_tokens.py in lane RI's shape (dry-run default, --land refuses without a ruling id), ~950 nodes / ~3,000 edges (aliasOf, bindsToken, composite), sixth family chip, grammar addition to meta.schema.json, selftest + validator simulation
shortlist.s274_D12: PASS — structural joins only (JSON reference chain + prefix parse of the meta tokens field); the prose tail stays $note

shortlist.name: NEIGHBOURS
shortlist.plain: For any node, show the ten nodes that read most like it, marked unratified — a place for Dave and a lane to find the rule-to-component and rule-to-principle bindings the graph is missing, never a place the agent takes an edge from.
closes: candidate recall for G2, G3, G4 only — nothing structural
shortlist.cost: one lane (Opus build, Fable review of the first candidate page): index over label + $note text; dependency choice is Dave's — a local embedding model (new dependency the pack does not carry) or the pure-Python _ngram.py shingle/Jaccard fallback (P-269-3 widened)
shortlist.s274_D12: FAILS if landed as edges; PASSES only as advisory display, dashed, proposedType null — exactly the ruling's shape

refused: LLM entity/relationship extraction over guidelines or rulings (GraphRAG index stage, Graphiti ingestion) — s274-D12's 27 candidates at scale
LLM-written community summaries as nodes — prose wearing an id; compile views (P-269-8) are the container
Embedding-derived edges landed in metas or _ruling_edges.json — s276-D5 did not widen the name-match tier
Chain inference across the PROSE `cites` edge (obeys ∘ cites ⇒ appliesTo) — a manufactured obligation
A triple store / OWL reasoner / RDF-star migration — the pack is pure Python; ruling: nodes already reify
Graphiti/Zep or Mem0/Letta as the runtime memory — extraction + a database, memory-shaped persistence
Decay, salience or recency weighting on rules and rulings — the 2604.11364 category error; inForce is the only temporal signal
Auto-resolving the 51 dangling mustNotNeighbour notes by sibling name-match — A2 judges, Dave ratifies
Widening appliesTo (sc→component) into obeys to fix Q4 at a stroke — erases the join class A1 measured
Shipping the whole graph in the pack for Copilot to read — 798,152 tokens

measure.$method: tiktoken cl100k_base; today = whole file(s) the agent must read for the question with no query surface; door = output tokens of the existing door if any; graph_slice = answering edges serialised {type,s,t,label,note}, averaged over five samples

questions.question: what governs this component?
questions.today_reads: _rulings.json (grep governs[] for the component name) + the meta's edges.governedBy
questions.door: _consult.py '<component>' --json (keyword; returns rulings by text match, not by governs edge)

questions.question: which components does this rule bind?
questions.today_reads: _rules-index.json (the rule row) + grep all 138 metas for edges.obeys[].ref == rule id
questions.door: none (consult finds the rule text, not its bindings)

questions.question: what principle underlies this rule and what is its grade?
questions.today_reads: _rules-index.json + _ux_principle_nodes.json (or brain/principles.json) and guess the link by reading

questions.question: which rules conflict for this component?
questions.today_reads: the meta's edges.obeys + the cited rows of _rules-index.json + the guideline .md files (conflict is stated nowhere)
questions.graph_answer: PARTIAL 7.3% (obeys list only; 'conflict' has no edge type)

questions.question: what did Dave rule about this and when?
questions.today_reads: _rulings.json read/grepped whole (813 KB) — the date and 'ruled' sentence live only there
questions.graph_answer: ANSWERED via 2 hops (governs + ruledIn), typed direct 0%

questions.question: what evidence supports that ruling?
questions.today_reads: _rulings.json — find the entry (grep) and read evidence[]; the entry itself is ~300-600 tokens once found
questions.door: _consult.py --fetch <id> (only if the ruling is in the consult index)

questions.question: which components answer this intent / data shape?
questions.today_reads: chart-intents.json + roles.json + grep 138 metas for answers/shape

questions.question: what must this component not sit next to?
questions.today_reads: the component's own meta (edges.mustNotNeighbour, 51 of 70 are dangling notes)

questions.question: what tokens does this component consume and what breaks if I change one?
questions.today_reads: the meta's token bindings + canon.css (588K) or tokens/*.json (528K); blast radius only in _GRAPH-REPORT.md (1.8K, 55-component reach for text/default)

questions.question: which pattern / context is this component used in?
what is the accessible-name / WCAG obligation here?
questions.today_reads: grep the 55 compliance/rules/*.json for applies_to containing the component (read all 55)
questions.door: none (compliance is not in the consult index as sc records)

questions.question: what icon/logo/photo may I use here?
questions.today_reads: icons.manifest.json (41K) + photography manifest + the snippet, by eye
questions.graph_answer: UNANSWERABLE (no asset: kind) — lane RI proposes 688 nodes / 1,299 edges (5520d43)
